text.tspan: We must cross the river on our own
For there is no bridge to help us
We must wait for the night to pass
For in the darkness, roam the shadows
We must rush through the icy storms
Find a shelter, Build a fire
And keep moving on the next day,
Leaving the shadows in our wake
For we must keep going on
To the dream that we chase,
One that is still far away,
We go on, we go on.
For we are sure to catch that vision
And so we go, so we go.
